title: German Rouladen
description: Bacon, onions and pickles are wrapped in thin slices of flank steak, browned in butter, then simmered in beef broth. Serve with spaetzle to soak up the gravy.
ingredients: German stone ground mustard, to taste

steps.text: Cut the flank steak into thin filets; about 1/4 inch thick and 3 inches wide.
Generously spread one side of each filet with mustard to taste. Place bacon, onions and pickle slices on each filet and form into a roll. Use string or toothpicks to hold the roll together.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and melt butter. Place the rolls in the butter and saute until browned.
Pour in 2 1/2 cups of water and add the bouillon cube; stirring to dissolve the bouillon cube. Simmer the rolls for about an hour.

video.description: In this video, learn how to make one of Germany’s most famous dishes. Rouladen are beef rolls stuffed with bacon, onions, mustard and pickles, then browned and simmered in gravy made from their own drippings. Chef Nicole McLaughlin has all of the tips and tricks you need to produce this delectable main dish even though this classic European recipe is new to her. Serve these meaty rolls with mashed potatoes or fresh steamed vegetables for a complete meal.
